findings.summary: The Log contact Save affordance now accepts future event times for planned meetings, but the operation it invokes still requires a nonfuture event time and rejects future times.
findings.evidence: Affordance: "preconditions: [Owned contact, Valid event time]" and "Date and time; a future time records a planned meeting"; operation.contact.log: "preconditions: [Owned contact, Nonfuture event time]" ... "failure: [Future event time is rejected, ...]"

findings.summary: Step c4 now offers to plan the next meeting, but none of its branches leads to a planning path; the only outcomes are log contact or skip logging.
findings.evidence: "action: Log what happened, or plan the next meeting?" with next: "- to: c5 when: log contact" and "- to: e2 when: skip logging"

findings.summary: The new planned-event concept is not defined anywhere: nothing says how the planned flag is set or cleared, and the Met this goal checkbox can still be checked for a future event, so the new invariant and S.webapp.qualification are not reconciled.
findings.evidence: "- { name: planned, type: boolean }"; "A planned event never qualifies before its time has passed"; S.webapp.qualification: "A ContactEvent must qualify only when the owner explicitly marks that it met this goal"
